gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.

gaps.hint: noun: the state of being free from rule
gaps.explanation: 'Gain independence' = become self-governing; the noun form follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.
Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
